offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures asphalt plants, aggregate processing equipment, mobile crushing and screening machines, underground boring equipment and energy systems. Sells mainly to road builders, asphalt and aggregate producers, and mining and energy companies, through direct sales and dealers worldwide.

primary_products.value: asphalt plants; aggregate processing equipment; mobile crushing and screening equipment; horizontal directional drills; thermal fluid heaters

primary_services.value: aftermarket parts supply; equipment repair and maintenance; installation and commissioning

customer_segment.value: B2B: road contractors, asphalt producers, aggregate quarry operators, mining companies, energy developers

end_markets.value: road and infrastructure construction; aggregates and mining; energy and biomass; utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: plants and machines sold to contractors and producers; service fees: replacement parts, repairs and field service

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds plants and machines from purchased components, sold to contractors and producers

geography_served.value: global: Sells in the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, Africa, South America and Asia through subsidiaries and dealers

specialization.value: related lines: asphalt, aggregate, mining and energy equipment sharing road and quarry customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales engineers selling to large contractors and producers; distributors / dealers: independent equipment dealers in many countries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: emissions, machine safety and export control rules for equipment sales
